data.title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
data.description:
MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und Longevity-Health Behandlungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen.

Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als die führende Marke für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren.

Unser Erfolgsmodell basiert auf einem klaren Anspruch: höchste medizinische Qualität ohne Kompromisse zugänglich für Alle.

Unsere Behandlungen werden ausschließlich von Ärzten durchgeführt. Wir arbeiten mit den hochwertigsten Produkten führender Hersteller und setzen auf standardisierte Prozesse, intensive Schulungen und eine konsequent hohe Behandlungs- und Servicequalität.

Unser Ziel ist nicht der kurzfristige "Verkauf" einzelner Behandlungen, sondern der Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch Qualität, Vertrauen und ein konstant exzellentes Kundenerlebnis.

Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden.

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir mit MY HEALTH & BEAUTY aktiv voran.

Aufgaben

Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 oder 100 Standorte schafft.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Verwalter bestehender Strukturen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Strukturen hinterfragt, Schwachstellen erkennt, Lösungen entwickelt und diese konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der strategisch denkt und selbst vor Ort ist, mit Teams arbeitet, Trainings durchführt, Probleme löst und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Deine Verantwortung

Du trägst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Standorte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unsere Operations kontinuierlich weiter.

Leadership & People

Du führst unsere Kollegen und späteren Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass Führung nicht nur auf dem Papier stattfindet, sondern im täglichen Geschäft spürbar ist.

Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst Verantwortlichkeiten.

Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig, entwickelst sie weiter.

Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um.

Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten.

Training & Development

Du entwickelst strukturierte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für unsere operativen Teams.

Du führst Trainings selbst durch und entwickelst gleichzeitig Strukturen, mit denen Wissen innerhalb der Organisation skalierbar weitergegeben werden kann.

Du etablierst klare Standards für Onboarding, Führung, Verkauf, Kundenservice und operative Abläufe.

Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen.

Operational Excellence

Du analysierst die operativen Prozesse des Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage.

Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert.

Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert.

Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht.

Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind.

Dein Anspruch ist, dass ein Kunde unabhängig vom Standort ein konstant hohes MY-HEALTH-&-BEAUTY-Erlebnis erhält.

Performance & KPIs

Du definierst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die relevanten operativen KPIs und stellst sicher, dass diese verstanden und konsequent gesteuert werden.

Dazu gehören insbesondere Produktivität, Personaleinsatz, Auslastung, Umsatzperformance, Kundenbindung, Servicequalität und operative Effizienz.

Wenn ein Standort seine Ziele verfehlt, analysierst du nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern findest heraus, warum.

Anschließend entwickelst du konkrete Maßnahmen, definierst Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher.

Customer Experience & Qualitätsanspruch

Wir wollen nicht durchschnittlich gut sein.

Unser Anspruch ist ein außergewöhnlich hohes Niveau in jedem einzelnen Standort.

Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Standards hinsichtlich Kundenservice, Organisation, Sauberkeit, Auftreten, Kommunikation und operativer Qualität konsequent eingehalten werden.

Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor aus kleinen Problemen strukturelle Probleme werden.

Dein Ziel ist klar:

Aus 10 erfolgreichen Standorten eine skalierbare, professionelle Operations-Struktur zu bauen, die auch mit weiteren 20, 30 oder 100 Standorten funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Diese Position ist bewusst nicht für jeden geeignet.

Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlich leistungsorientierten Menschen mit einem sehr hohen eigenen Anspruch.

Du solltest bereits bewiesen haben, dass du Menschen führen, operative Strukturen verbessern und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen kannst.

Was du zwingend mitbringen solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Führungserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen operativen Organisation.

Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Teams und mehrerer Führungsebenen.

Idealerweise hast du bereits Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte oder dezentrale operative Einheiten getragen.

Du hast Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeiter nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern tatsächlich zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und leistungsfähiger zu machen.

Du kannst professionelle Trainingskonzepte entwickeln und bist gleichzeitig stark genug in Kommunikation und Auftreten, diese Trainings selbst durchzuführen.

Du bist zahlengetrieben und kannst aus KPIs konkrete operative Entscheidungen ableiten.

Du hast bereits Prozesse aufgebaut oder grundlegend verbessert und kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Arbeit messbar zu besseren Ergebnissen geführt hat.

Du kannst gleichzeitig strategisch und extrem hands-on arbeiten.

Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verbindlich und scheust dich nicht davor, auch unangenehme Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsgefühl und wartest bei Problemen nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Person, die möglichst viele Aufgaben delegiert und Operations hauptsächlich aus Meetings und Reports heraus steuert.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das Unternehmen wirklich verstehen will.

Jemanden, der regelmäßig in unseren Standorten präsent ist.

Der mit Mitarbeitern spricht.

Der Kunden beobachtet.

Der Prozesse selbst durchläuft.

Der Probleme sieht, bevor sie in einem Dashboard auftauchen.

Und der anschließend Strukturen schafft, damit diese Probleme dauerhaft gelöst werden.

Du solltest einen außergewöhnlich hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Umsetzung haben.

Wir arbeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen. Damit gehen Veränderung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und Phasen außergewöhnlicher Belastung einher.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung nicht an seiner Stellenbeschreibung oder an der Uhr festmacht. Wenn eine wichtige Standorteröffnung ansteht, ein Team Unterstützung benötigt oder ein operatives Problem gelöst werden muss, erwarten wir Ownership und die Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen.

Was für uns zählt, sind Ergebnisse.

Dein Mindset

Du denkst unternehmerisch.

Du willst gestalten statt verwalten.

Du stellst hohe Anforderungen an dich selbst und an dein Team.

Du kannst Menschen begeistern, aber genauso klare Grenzen setzen.

Du bist extrem lösungsorientiert.

Du suchst bei Problemen nicht nach Erklärungen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach dem schnellsten nachhaltigen Weg, es zu lösen.

Du kannst Prioritäten setzen und auch unter erheblichem Druck klar entscheiden.

Du hast keine Angst vor Verantwortung.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

Eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung und Skalierung von MY HEALTH&BEAUTY.

Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit attraktivem Fixgehalt und leistungsabhängigem Bonus.

Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Die Möglichkeit, Strukturen nicht nur zu übernehmen, sondern ein Operations-System für die nächsten 20, 30 oder 100 Standorte aktiv mit aufzubauen.

Keine Konzernbürokratie und keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Ideen können schnell entschieden und umgesetzt werden.

Und vor allem: eine Rolle, in der du wirklich etwas aufbauen kannst, anstatt lediglich einen bestehenden Betrieb zu verwalten.

Du möchtest nicht einfach einen weiteren Job. Du möchtest maßgeblich daran beteiligt sein, ein Unternehmen von 10 Standorten zu der führenden Marken seiner Branche zu skalieren.

Wenn du dich darin wiederfindest und bereits nachweislich auf einem hohen Niveau gearbeitet hast, möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen.

Client Success Manager (SMB) (m/f/d) - German-speaking
data.description:
What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

As a Client Success Manager you’re responsible for helping our customers achieve the best possible impact by using the Leapsome platform and for building and maintaining meaningful relationships with our customers. Master the challenges of growth and help us further shape our growth trajectory. You will focus on our SMB customers.


What is your job?

​​Customer Relationship & Growth

  • Proactively manage customer relationships to minimize churn, identify expansion opportunities, and execute cross-selling strategies that align with customer needs while achieving commercial targets

  • Own customer renewals and drive net revenue retention across your book of business

  • Create the best SaaS customer experience, advise on HR best practices, and drive continued adoption

  • Support customers to rollout additional parts of the platform later and enable them to have the best possible impact by using Leapsome

Customer Success Operations

  • Monitor and improve customer success KPIs including NRR, GRR, customer health scores, adoption rates, and time-to-value

  • Work to make customer success processes and structures scalable as we grow

  • Leverage customer success platforms and CRM tools to track engagement and proactively identify at-risk accounts

Product & Feedback Loop

  • Gather feedback and user stories directly from our customers, come up with ideas to improve the product

  • Work closely with the product and engineering team to constantly improve the product (You actively contribute to our product roadmap!)

  • Build lasting relationships with our customers and help them build better companies

Who are we looking for?

Required Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent work experience; 3+ years in Customer Success, Sales, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally in a B2B SaaS company

  • Fluent in English and German both in written and spoken form

  • Proven track record of managing customer renewals and driving net revenue retention, or similar experience

Skills & Attributes

  • You enjoy negotiating contracts and identifying & converting expansion opportunities

  • You are a people-person and curious to fully understand your counterpart

  • You excel at communicating complex processes in a simple way

  • You strive to provide outstanding customer experiences by effectively communicating the value and ROI of our solutions, ensuring customers recognize the impact on their business goals and objectives

  • You are process-driven and continuously work to improve existing processes

  • You have a good understanding of technology and make decisions based on data

  • Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero)

  • You are passionate about the future of work and continuous learning at work, and you want to join us in building an exceptional team and company to have real impact in this space

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in HR tech or People Operations software

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS startup environment

Benefits at Leapsome

  • Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.

  • Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.

  • Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.

  • Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.

  • Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.

  • Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.

  • Hybrid and flexible work: Spend 2 days a week with the team in our Berlin office, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

  • Impact: Join a fast-growing HR platform trusted by more than 2,000 companies worldwide: you'll help shape how companies run HR and grow their people in one connected system.

  • Culture: A diverse, international team that values open feedback and celebrates wins, big and small.

  • Sponsored lunch: Lunch is on us every Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Work from anywhere: Work from a different location for up to 2 months a year.

  • Monthly team activities: Join Feierabend, a monthly budget to get-together in Berlin — hosted by employees, for employees.

This role is based in Berlin and the salary range for this position is €48,000 - €75,000 + Bonus + Equity. View our full compensation framework here.

Leapsome aims to pay generously and fairly. If the listed range isn’t working for your situation, please tell us early in the process, we’d rather have that conversation than lose a great candidate over a number we may be able to address.

If your role or skillset isn’t covered in our compensation framework, it’s likely because we haven’t hired enough in that area yet. We’ll build a data-backed range before we make you an offer, and we’ll share our thinking with you as early as we can.

This note is published for transparency. It reflects our compensation philosophy as of June 2026 and describes our general global approach — it is not a contract, offer, or entitlement to any salary, increase, or bonus, and may change at any time. Individual compensation is always governed solely by your written employment agreement and applicable local law.



Leapsome’s values

We stay true to our values in everything we do at Leapsome. 

  • Impact is everything — We aim high, focus on the outcomes that matter and say no to the rest.

  • Speed is our advantage — We move fast with intent — simplifying, automating, and learning as we go.

  • Owners without egos — We trust owners and expect excellence in return. We take responsibility individually, support each other, and win as a team.

  • Candid is kind — We speak up early and respectfully. We assume good intent, stay curious, and care about each other’s growth.

Excited to be part of Leapsome? 😊

Just send us your CV. You won't need to input any information already mentioned on your CV later on - promise! 🤙

A cover letter isn’t necessary, but we’d really appreciate a brief answer to these questions: Why Leapsome? Why you?

We look forward to getting to know you!

You can find more about what our colleagues think about working at Leapsome here 👉 ✨✨✨ Glassdoor ✨✨✨ Kununu✨✨✨

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Help us make work fulfilling for everyone!

At Leapsome, we want work to be the best it can be for everyone. We help companies create environments where people can achieve shared goals, build authentic relationships, learn, and grow together.

Put simply; our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone. And we know how to get there. But we can only do this by “walking our talk” and building a diverse and inclusive company where people — not just the business — thrive.


Apply now 👇 or keep scrolling to read more about what makes Leapsome a unique workplace!

data.title: Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.

What You Will Work On

  • Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
  • Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
  • You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
  • Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
  • Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
  • Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
  • Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
  • AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
  • Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
  • German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

  • Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
  • Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
  • Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

data.title: Solution Architect (all genders)
data.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams. 

  • 7+ years of experience, 2+ in the industry
  • Full ownership of architecture & governance
  • You define processes and drive them with the team
  • Deepexpertisein scaling, resilience, and redundancy
  • Proactive mentoring of all engineers

Mid-Level - You grow into architectural responsibility – with real scope and clear support. 
  • 5+ years of experience, 2+ years with architecture focus
  • Co-design solution architecture with senior support
  • Gradually take on governance responsibilities
  • Interest in mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Openness to learningnew technologies
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. 


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. 

Additionally, we offer: 

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities

  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity

data.title: FP&A- Working Student
data.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment.

Shiftmove exists to make this simple. We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets.

Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the Role

Joining our FP&A team as a Working Student, you won't just be doing basic data entry, you’ll have real ownership from day one.

You’ll play a key role in strengthening our monthly financial reporting and budgeting processes across our PE-backed, multi-entity SaaS group. By consolidating costs and building clear, vendor-level insights, you will directly enable our budget owners to make smarter, faster decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Spend Transparency: Consolidate accounting cost data across multiple systems monthly, categorizing and tagging line items by vendor and cost type.
  • Optimize Financial Models: Maintain and refine Excel models tracking actual spend against budget and forecast.
  • Empower Budget Owners: Deliver clearer, more timely spend visibility to department heads to help optimize operational budgets.
  • Automate & Improve: Leverage advanced Excel features, SQL, and PowerBI to automate recurring data flows, account reconciliations, and data validation.
  • Innovate & Own: Proactively contribute ideas to streamline our processes, taking real ownership of your workstreams.

What You Bring

  • Academic Background: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Spreadsheet & Data Skills: Advanced Excel proficiency (XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, Power Query). Exposure to SQL, Snowflake, or PowerBI is a strong plus.
  • Financial Basics: Solid understanding of financial accounting fundamentals (P&L structure, cost categorization, accruals logic).
  • Detail & Precision: High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy across repetitive workflows.
  • Language & Availability: Fluent in English (written and spoken). Based in Berlin and available to work 20 hours/week for at least 12 months. Exposure to SaaS or PE environments is a bonus

Benefits

  • Practical Ownership: Take responsibility for your own projects and gain valuable experience in FP&A at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company.
  • Flexible Working: Flexible working hours that can be easily combined with your studies.
  • Professional Development: An annual training budget of €750 to support your personal and professional growth.
  • Wellbeing: Access to nilo.health as well as an additional Mental Health Day per year.
  • Perks & Mobility: Subsidy for the Deutschlandticket or an Urban Sports Club membership.
  • Team Culture: Regular team and company events, plus the opportunity to work with colleagues from over 40 nations.

We mean it:

With over 40 nationalities, we are united by our dedication and a shared belief in our purpose: to simplify mobility operations for businesses. Different backgrounds, career paths, and perspectives are what make the work better.

What we care about is simple: people who take responsibility, make it happen, and care deeply about the work. If you're unsure whether you fit, apply anyway. And if you need anything adjusted during the process, just tell us, and we'll make it work.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Show Production
data.description:
The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality.

You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate.

At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems.

Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable.


Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles.

You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests.

You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite.

You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior.

You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows.


What you need to succeed in this role

Your skills and qualifications

  • A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation.

  • Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language such as Python.

  • Knowledge of C++ with a wish to learn more.

  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and CI-based validation workflows.

  • A good understanding of digital audio fundamentals.

  • Experience testing desktop applications, in all major platforms.

  • Experience with audio plugin testing.

  • Good understanding of software architecture, testability, observability, and maintainable engineering practices.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain technical risks, test strategies, and failure modes clearly to developers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • An eye for detail, a tad of perfectionism, a can-do mentality, and the courage to take on new challenges

  • A mindset of curiosity and excellence

  • Positive vibes and desire to contribute to a productive and collegial working environment


Nice to haves

  • Experience with networked audio or real-time network protocols is highly valuable, especially AES67, Ravenna, Dante, RTP, PTP, multicast, or related technologies.

  • Experience with spatial audio technologies.

  • Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

data.title: Go-to-Market Engineer – AI & Automation (m/f/d)
data.description:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you will own the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


This is not a traditional RevOps or analytics role.


We are looking for a builder who can understand a commercial problem in the morning and start shipping a solution in the afternoon. You will combine software engineering, automation, AI, data, and commercial thinking to make our GTM organization faster and more effective.


You will have significant ownership over how autarc builds its GTM infrastructure as we scale across Europe.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Build our GTM operating system

Own and continuously improve the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Deploy AI into real workflows

Move AI beyond prototypes.

Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Own GTM data & analytics

Create a reliable data foundation for our commercial organization.

Connect and structure data across our CRM, calling infrastructure, product, billing, and other GTM systems.

Build dashboards and internal tools that give teams real-time visibility into the metrics that matter: pipeline, activity, conversion, ARR, retention, and individual and team performance.

Make sure we can answer important commercial questions with data rather than assumptions.


Build, don’t just recommend

You will personally implement what you design.

Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

Technology is a means, not the outcome.

Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and can independently ship solutions using Python and/or TypeScript.

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs.

  • You understand modern AI tooling and have already built applications or workflows using LLMs.

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

  • You understand how modern B2B SaaS companies generate revenue and are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems connecting them.

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification.

  • You prioritize commercial impact over technical perfection.

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have previously worked as a GTM Engineer, Growth Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, RevOps Engineer, or in a similarly hands-on technical role.

  • You have experience with B2B SaaS GTM stacks and tools such as HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms.

  • You have built internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You understand data modeling and have experience building a data warehouse or analytics infrastructure.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

A high-ownership role with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure from the ground up instead of maintaining legacy systems.

Direct collaboration with our founders and GTM leadership.

A fast-moving environment where you can ship and test ideas quickly.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

data.title: Werkstudent Kundenservice | Spätschicht & Samstagsdienst (m/w/d)
data.description:
Gemeinsam großartig – werde Teil des Teams

Als Werkstudent Kundenservice | Spätschicht & Samstagsdienst (m/w/d) bei WattFox  trägst du maßgeblich zu unserem Erfolg bei, indem du die Projekte unserer Kundschaft mit ihnen telefonisch so detailliert ausarbeitest, dass sie folgend schnellstmöglich, kostenlos und unverbindlich an die passenden Fachfirmen weitergeleitet werden können.

Starte als Werkstudent (m/w/d) ab 16h/Woche bis 20/h Woche im unserem Headquarter in Freiburg zum 15.10.2026 durch!


Deine Mission

  • Kundenerfahrung: Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Interessierte, die über unsere Angebotsvergleichsportale Kontakt zu Produkten wie bspw. Photovoltaik, Heizungen oder Immobilien aufnehmen (kein Verkauf!).
  • Anrufmanagement: Du kontaktierst unsere Anfragenden telefonisch oder nimmst eingehende Anrufe entgegen.
  • Datenaufnahme: Mithilfe von Leitfäden führst du durch das Gespräch und dokumentierst die Projektdetails, damit sie folgend an die passenden Fachfirmen (z.B. Solarteur-Betriebe) weitergeleitet werden können.
  • CRM- und Toolmanagement: Du nutzt moderne Tools wie virtuelle Telefonanlagen und unser CRM-System zum Verwalten eingehender Anfragen.


Deine Talente

  • Immatrikulation: Du bist für mind. zwei weitere Semester an einer Universität oder Hochschule immatrikuliert.
  • Call-Agent-Erfahrung: Du bringst bereits Erfahrungen aus den Bereichen Call Center, Customer Service, Inbound, Client Support oder Customer Care mit.
  • Kundenorientierung: Du überzeugst mit einem serviceorientierten Auftreten und zielgerichteter Kommunikation am Telefon sowie Freude am Umgang mit Kundinnen und Kunden.
  • Digitalaffinität: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen Technik-Tools einer Büroumgebung und bringst eine generelle Digitalaffinität mit, durch die du dich schnell in Neues einarbeiten kannst.
  • Deutschkenntnisse: Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache in Wort und Schrift auf dem Niveau C1.


Unser Angebot

  • #DasWichtigste: Du bekommst zum Einstieg 14 Euro pro Stunde zzgl. attraktiver leistungsbezogener Zusatzvergütung. Um so richtig durchzustarten, profitierst du von unserem Top-Performer-Modell, welches dir ermöglicht, deinen Erfolg selbst zu beeinflussen.

  • #Planungssicherheit: Während deines Semesters kannst du ab 16 bis 20 Stunden die Woche arbeiten. In den Semesterferien 40 Stunden die Woche nach Rücksprache. Deine Zeiten und Schichten passt du zu Beginn fest an dein Studium an. Durch gleichbleibende Schichtzeiten hast du dein Semester fest im Griff. 

  • #SchnellUndUnkompliziert: Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist digital und kompakt. Wir kommen schnell zu Entscheidungen und melden uns nach Eingang deines aussagekräftigen Lebenslaufes innerhalb der nächsten 3 Tage bei dir.

  • #AnkommenUndLoslegen: Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, individuelle Coachings und regelmäßige Schulungen zu all unseren Produkten ermöglichen dir, mit- und weiterzukommen. Damit du durchstarten kannst.

  • #Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Je nach deinen Interessen und Stärken bieten sich weitere Aufgabengebiete und spannende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten. In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen arbeiten wir gemeinsam an deinem Erfolg. 

  • #Ausgewogenheit: 20 Tage Urlaub, Zeiterfassung mit Überstundenausgleich – selbstverständlich. Mit zahlreichen Sportgeräten im Office, Fitness- und Coffee-Breaks, Snacks und Sweets im Pausenraum oder auch Corporate Benefits für mehr Spaß beim Shoppen setzen wir Ansätze für regenerative Pausen. Zeit ist ein Investment. In dich und uns.

  • GemeinsamGroßartig: Als kununu Top Company 2026 stehen bei uns Erfolg, Teamgeist und Spaß im Vordergrund. Bleib durch unsere unternehmensweiten Jour Fixe am Ball und erlebe Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern, Stammtische und viele Events mehr, die unser Wir-Gefühl stärken.

Und das war noch nicht alles! Schau dich auf unserer Benefit-Übersicht um.


Wer wir sind

Seit 2011 vom Start-up zum grünen Marktführer! Jeden Monat unterstützen wir mehrere zehntausend Menschen dabei, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu finden und einfach richtige Entscheidungen zu treffen. Wir gehen die Hürde zwischen Verbrauchenden und Anbietenden mit unseren Online-Angebotsvergleichen an, ermitteln die individuellen Bedürfnisse der Anfragenden und bringen sie mit den passenden Anbietenden zusammen – ein Win-Win für alle.

data.title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
data.description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen unseres Trainee-Programms durchlaufen Sie die vollständige und praxisnahe Ausbildung zum/zur Financial Consultant. Bei uns erlernen Sie das Handwerk moderner Finanzberatung von Grund auf.   • Konzeptentwicklung: Erstellung und Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Finanzkonzepte für anspruchsvolle Mandanten.
  • Aftersales & Kundenbetreuung: Langfristige, nachhaltige Betreuung und Begleitung Ihrer Mandanten in allen Lebensphasen.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • Ein kurz bevorstehender oder bereits abgeschlossener (Fach-)Hochschulabschluss.

data.title: Praktikum im Financial Consulting (m/w/d)
data.description:
Siehst du deine berufliche Zukunft im Finanzbereich und willst herausfinden, wie echtes Unternehmertum funktioniert? Suchst du nach einem Praktikum, das dir nicht nur theoretisches Wissen, sondern echte Praxisnähe, wertvolle Kontakte und eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung bietet?

Aufgaben

  • Terminmanagement: Aktive Unterstützung bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen.
  • Neukundengewinnung: Mitwirkung bei vertrieblichen Maßnahmen und der Akquise.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist im Studium (wirtschaftlicher Schwerpunkt von Vorteil, aber kein Muss) oder befindest dich in einer Orientierungsphase.

data.title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) Accounting & Controlling
data.description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Wir bieten dir die Chance, schon während deines Studiums Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und aktiv weiterzuentwickeln. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Mitarbeit bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen - du unterstützt uns aktiv im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst, worauf es in der Finanzberichterstattung wirklich ankommt.
  • Erstellung von Reports und Finanzanalysen - deine Auswertungen liefern die Grundlage für fundierte Entscheidungen – für Fachbereiche, Führungskräfte und andere Stakeholder im Unternehmen.
  • Intercompany-Abstimmungen begleiten und optimieren - du trägst dazu bei, dass unsere konzerninternen Verrechnungen stimmen – strukturiert, nachvollziehbar und termingerecht.
  • Analyse der Datenqualität im Management Reporting - du gehst Auffälligkeiten auf den Grund, analysierst Konten und Kostenstellen entlang der GuV und Bilanz und unterstützt bei der Klärung von Abweichungen.
  • Datenflüsse zwischen Lucanet und Looker steuern und optimieren – du überführst Daten zwischen unseren Systemen, stellst sicher, dass diese korrekt und konsistent in unseren Dashboards abgebildet werden, und unterstützt uns dabei, Datenqualität, Aufbereitung und Darstellung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Datenimporte in unsere Lucanet-Datenbank übernehmen - du sorgst eigenverantwortlich dafür, dass unsere Zahlen korrekt, vollständig und aktuell in den Systemen abgebildet sind.
  • Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten im Bereich Accounting & Controlling - ob Prozessoptimierung oder Tool-Einführung – du bringst dich mit ein und hilfst uns, den Bereich aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
data.description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

data.title: Senior Android Engineer - KMP
data.description:
About the team

SumUp's Point-of-Sale (POS) solution empowers cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and other businesses to operate efficiently and grow. It offers a wide range of features, including product catalogs, inventory management, business analytics, compliance support, and loyalty tools.

Our POS solution integrates seamlessly into the SumUp SuperApp, which supports both our proprietary register hardware and mobile devices like tablets and phones.

As a Senior Android Developer, you'll collaborate with a dynamic, cross-functional team of Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, and fellow engineers.

About the role

We're evolving toward a Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) strategy, enabling shared development across Android and iOS. In this role, you'll learn, refine, and help implement this technology, shaping the future of our mobile apps.

You're a developer who values user-centric design, precision, and seamless collaboration. You bring structure to communication and thrive in a cross-functional environment. 

This role is on-site in Berlin, where face-to-face interactions spark innovation and teamwork.

What you'll do

  • Build new features for the item catalog within the SumUp SuperApp
  • Help improve the architecture of the application and contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform strategy
  • Enhance and maintain our unified android app, distributed across 60+ countries, ensuring high-quality, scalable solutions
  • Shape the product's evolution by identifying opportunities for improvement and contributing to daily decision-making
  • Write thorough documentation and implement robust testing for features before shipping
  • Collaborate closely with Designer, Product Manager and Android engineers to deliver a unified UX experience across platforms
  • Coach and mentor other engineers

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You have 8+ years experience in mobile engineering with Android and Kotlin.
  • You have 2+ years of experience working with Jetpack Compose.
  • You have a solid understanding of software design patterns (e.g., MVVM, MVI) and expertise in building modular, scalable app architectures.
  • You have good knowledge of reactive programming (Flow, Coroutines and Concurrency).
  • You have a strong grasp of testing best practices: knowing what to test, why, and how to write resilient tests.
  • You strive for clean code, and you are flexible to balance pragmatism and perfection.
  • You have a keen interest in multi-platform development using Kotlin Multiplatform.

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.

  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.

  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world

  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)

  • 28 days paid leave + 1 for birthday

  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers

  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions

data.title: Senior WordPress Webdesigner (m/w/d) mit Strategiekompetenz
data.description:
Gute digitale Projekte brauchen mehr als schöne Oberflächen. Sie brauchen eine Idee. Eine Richtung. Und jemanden, der beides zusammenbringt.

Du hast ein Auge für gutes Design, denkst konzeptionell und strategisch und entwickelst aus Kundenanforderungen klare Konzepte und überzeugende digitale Lösungen? Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, denkst weiter und hast Lust, Projekte von Anfang an mitzugestalten? Dann könnten wir ziemlich gut zusammenpassen.

Wir sind zacher media – eine Digitalagentur aus Köln und Teil der zacher group. Wir entwickeln digitale Lösungen für mittelständische Unternehmen und verbinden dabei die Bereiche web, design & strategy – von der Konzeption und Umsetzung moderner Websites über kreative Designlösungen und digitale Kampagnen bis hin zur strategischen Kommunikation.

Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort einen Senior WordPress Webdesigner (m/w/d) mit Strategiekompetenz in 4 oder 5 Tagen pro Woche.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du bist bei uns nicht einfach die Person, die ein Briefing umsetzt.
Du denkst mit, entwickelst Ideen und bringst Projekte gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden auf den Punkt.

  • Konzeption, Design und Entwicklung moderner Websites und Webshops mit WordPress
  • Anpassungen mittels HTML & CSS sowie Unterstützung bei SEO-Maßnahmen
  • Verantwortung für Websites von der Idee bis zum Go-Live
  • Entwicklung digitaler Strategien und Konzepte
  • Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kampagnen, visuellen Konzepten und (digitalen) Kommunikationsmitteln
  • Entwicklung von Marken- und Kommunikationsauftritten sowie Übersetzung strategischer Ziele in klare, kreative Lösungen
  • Beratung unserer Kunden und direkter Austausch auf Augenhöhe

Qualifikation

Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Webdesign mit, hast ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung und denkst strategisch.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Webdesign, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Entwicklung moderner Websites, Webshops und digitaler Auftritte
  • Sicherer Umgang mit WordPress, HTML & CSS sowie Erfahrung mit Divi, Elementor und gängigen WordPress-Plugins
  • Gute Kenntnisse in SEO und Webanalyse
  • Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Design, Marken und digitale Kommunikation
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Strategien, Konzepte und Kampagnen
  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Ideen und übersetzt Kundenanforderungen und strategische Ziele in überzeugende Lösungen
  • Sicheres Präsentieren und Vertreten eigener Konzepte sowie Freude am Kundenkontakt
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Photoshop sowie idealerweise weiteren Adobe-Programmen wie Illustrator oder InDesign
  • Kreativität, Eigeninitiative, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und lösungsorientiertes Denken

Benefits

Gute Arbeit braucht Raum für gute Ideen – und natürlich ein Umfeld, in dem man sich wohlfühlt.

  • Ein motiviertes Team auf Augenhöhe, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen
  • Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte für Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und Größen
  • 4- oder 5-Tage-Woche – du entscheidest, welches Modell zu dir passt
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie faire Home-Office- und Remote-Möglichkeiten
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Ein modernes Büro in Köln-Marsdorf mit guter Verkehrsanbindung und eigenen Parkplätzen
  • Moderne Ausstattung – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Teammeetings und unser Montagsfrühstück
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, in der neue Ideen willkommen sind
  • Und die wirklich wichtigen Dinge: Kaffee und frisches Obst sind natürlich auch am Start.

Du hast Lust auf spannende Projekte, starke Ideen und ein Team, das nicht bei der ersten Lösung stehen bleibt?

Dann lass uns kennenlernen. Schick uns deine Bewerbung und zeig uns, was du draufhast. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

data.title: AI Platform Working Student
data.description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You will work as a full member of the AI Core team, supporting the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. The team's core product is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): we keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations, and ensure every company in the group has a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and ship it to every company in the portfolio. Each company owns and administers their own Hub (L1 Support). The AI Core team drives the features, changes, and integrations that create value across all hubs and serves as the centre of expertise (L2 Support) when local teams need guidance or hands-on help.

You will have direct ownership of tasks, contribute your own ideas, and actively shape how the platform evolves. This is not an observation role, you will work on the same codebase and infrastructure as the rest of the team.

What You Will Work On

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain shared AI Hub instances across Azure and AWS
  • Build and test platform tools, functions, and custom AI agents based on specifications
  • Monitor platform health, uptime, logs, and configuration consistency across all deployed AI Hub instances
  • Build health-check, alerting, and reporting scripts that track version parity, uptime, cloud usage, and deployment status
  • Support containerized application deployment, environment configuration, secrets handling, and rollback processes
  • Implement and validate integrations with infrastructure and enterprise services such as MCP servers, Git/Bitbucket, Microsoft Graph, and data providers
  • Write deployment guides, runbooks, and onboarding documentation for new companies joining the platform
  • Monitor core platform and dependency releases, then summarize operational impact, upgrade steps, and risks for the group

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Strong Python skills, comfortable writing scripts, calling APIs, and building small applications
  • Comfortable with Bash/shell scripting and working in a Linux terminal
  • Basic familiarity with cloud infrastructure and application deployment on Azure or AWS
  • Practical experience using LLMs via API (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and deployment workflows
  • Ability to read and work from technical documentation independently
  • Strong written communication in English (fluent) and German (fluent)

Bonus

  • Cloud platform certifications in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud are a plus, especially when paired with hands-on deployment or operations experience
  • Experience with cloud application platforms, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agentic AI frameworks
  • Infrastructure as Code awareness (Bicep, Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with authentication concepts (OAuth, SSO, JWT)
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, or cloud operations tools such as Azure Monitor or CloudWatch

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • Work on infrastructure and tooling that directly shapes how 55+ software companies adopt AI, your output has immediate, visible impact across the group
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • Full integration into the AI Core team, contributing alongside senior engineers from day one, with a direct line to the CTO office
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise AI infrastructure across Azure and AWS in production
  • Access to enterprise AI tooling: Claude Code, Azure OpenAI, and a modern multi-cloud AI platform stack
  • Direct ownership of tasks with measurable impact, not support work or observation
  • Active investment in your development: mentorship from the AI Core team, exposure to real architecture decisions, and access to relevant events and conferences

How to Apply
