data.title: Patient Support Coordinator
data.description:
If you are brilliant with people, love solving problems and genuinely care about giving patients a great experience, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for a Patient Support Coordinator to join our growing team at Montu. This is a busy, hands-on role at the heart of our patient journey, supporting people who may be completely new to medical cannabis and helping make their experience with us as simple, smooth and reassuring as possible.

You will be speaking to patients every day, answering questions, coordinating appointments, supporting our clinicians and working across the business to get things sorted. Some days will be incredibly busy, priorities will change and you will need to think on your feet, so we need someone who takes ownership, stays calm and genuinely enjoys helping people.

The most important thing is the person. We can teach you our systems and processes. What we cannot teach is empathy, energy and the instinct to go that extra mile when someone needs your help.

If you are organised, proactive, great with people and want to be part of a team that is changing the way patients access medical cannabis in the UK, I would love to hear from you.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you’ll be a key part of the pharmacy team and play an important role in ensuring Montu patients and clinicians receive a seamless, high-quality service. You’ll be one of the main points of contact for patients, supporting them throughout their journey while also working closely with our clinical and operational teams.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Montu’s growing UK team and contribute to the development of our patient-facing operations. You’ll need to be organised, proactive and patient-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment.

The Patient Support Coordinator sits within the pharmacy team and requires a dynamic, patient-centric individual who is passionate about helping patients and clinicians get the best out of the service.

You’ll support the day-to-day running of the patient journey, working closely with clinicians, operations, governance, product and technology teams to ensure patients receive a smooth and professional experience.

What will you be doing?

  • Answer patient queries by telephone and email, providing clear, professional and empathetic support.

  • Schedule and coordinate patient appointments to optimise the patient experience.

  • Handle appointment payments accurately and efficiently.

  • Maintain patients’ electronic health records, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

  • Support the clinical team by:

    • Collecting patient data relating to long-term conditions.

    • Ensuring patients meet the criteria for an initial assessment in line with Montu’s inclusion and exclusion criteria.

    • Booking patients for initial and follow-up appointments.

    • Preparing for and taking minutes during multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings.

  • Support operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities.

  • Collate patient and service feedback and liaise with the Head of Governance regarding complaints and compliments.

  • Report incidents and significant events and work with the Head of Governance to support appropriate follow-up.

  • Support clinicians with operational queries and day-to-day service requirements.

  • Liaise with the Product and Tech Support teams to resolve technical issues.

  • Work closely with your line manager and the wider team to identify opportunities for service improvement.

  • Attend work-related meetings as required.

  • Maintain all mandatory training and remain familiar with company policies and SOPs.

  • Work flexibly across shifts when required.

What you need:

  • At least 2 years’ work experience.

  • Previous experience working in a healthcare environment is advantageous but not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

  • Good understanding of working within a highly regulated environment and following policies and SOPs.

  • High level of IT proficiency and confidence using multiple systems.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities and remain calm in a fast-paced environment.

  • Patient-focused, professional and proactive approach.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary.

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 37 days after one year, rising to 30 day after year 3 plus bank holidays.

  • 5% matched pension.

  • Private Health Care

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity

  • Cycle-to-work scheme.

  • Opportunities for learning, development and career progression.

  • A dynamic, collaborative and supportive working environment.

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients’ experiences and contribute to the growth of a forward-thinking healthcare organisation.

As a growing organisation, we offer a dynamic and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers, work collaboratively across teams and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

data.description:
What is the job?

Great patient care doesn't just happen in the consultation room, it starts with a well-organised, supported and connected team behind the scenes.

We are looking for a Medical Secretary to join Montu UK on a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover contract. In this fast-paced role, you'll be the organisational backbone of our clinical team, helping to keep everything running smoothly so our clinicians can focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional care to patients.

From coordinating clinician schedules and managing clinical administration to supporting meetings and keeping important documentation up to date, you'll play a key role in making sure our day-to-day operations run seamlessly. You'll be juggling priorities, solving problems and keeping things moving, no two days are the same.

If you're highly organised, naturally proactive, enjoy supporting others and get satisfaction from making sure everything is exactly where it needs to be, you'll fit right in.

What will you be doing?

As our Medical Secretary, you will be at the heart of keeping the clinical team organised and supported by:

  • Preparing, maintaining and updating clinician rotas to ensure excellent clinical coverage.

  • Resolving rota conflicts and communicating schedule changes quickly and effectively.

  • Providing day-to-day administrative support to clinicians and the wider medical team.

  • Working closely with other departments to ensure clinicians have the equipment, systems and support they need to do their jobs effectively.

  • Acting as the first point of contact for clinician queries relating to scheduling and administration.

  • Drafting professional correspondence and supporting day-to-day communications.

  • Managing sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality and professionalism.

  • Supporting operational projects and helping the team stay on track with key deadlines.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and make the clinical team's day-to-day operations even more efficient.

What do you need?

We're looking for someone who loves being organised, takes pride in supporting others and thrives when there's plenty to keep them busy. You'll be comfortable managing multiple priorities, confident communicating with different people and able to stay calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

You'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience in a Medical Secretary, healthcare administration or similar administrative role.

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a varied and fast-moving workload.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and healthcare or scheduling systems.

  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to work independently.

  • The ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

  • A genuine desire to support a clinical team and contribute to a positive patient experience.

data.description:
Marqeta is seeking a Senior Counsel, Commercial who will be an integral member of Marqeta’s Commercial Legal Team and strategic partner to the Revenue, Product and Finance Teams in the UK / EU Region.

As Senior Commercial Counsel, you will provide legal and business advice relating to commercial contracts entered into by Marqeta or Marqeta’s EU/UK subsidiaries, including agreements with customers, banks and network partners, and vendors in the EU and UK, and will help improve Marqeta’s contracting processes and procedures in the region. You will have a broad range of responsibilities and work in close partnership with cross-functional and geographically diverse teams supporting the development and delivery of Marqeta’s payment products and services. You will report to the Director, Assistant General Counsel.

This role will be based out of our London office in Holborn two days a week. Please speak to the recruiter for further details. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Work with sales, partnership, and procurement teams to support the sale and development of Marqeta’s products and services with a focus on Marqeta’s customers and partners in Europe. Specifically, you will negotiate strategic, complex and cross-border agreements with Marqeta’s customers and partners within Europe.

  • Assist with resolving complex issues in strategic customer, bank and network partner, and vendor agreements in Europe.

  • Support Marqeta’s expansion by partnering with cross-functional teams in sales, product, compliance, bank partnerships, and finance to help sell Marqeta’s products and services in Europe.

  • Work collaboratively across the Legal, Regulatory and Compliance team on cross-functional priorities and initiatives.

  • Collaborate on the development of agreement templates and playbooks for the Commercial Legal Team to drive scale, and cross-functional efficiencies, and offer creative solutions where appropriate.

  • Provide practical legal advice to the business and develop strong working relationships across the Company with cross-functional peers and other business stakeholders.

Who You Are

  • 4-7 years of experience practicing either in-house or at a reputable law firm, with at least 2 years working in or advising companies in the payments, fintech or financial services space

  • An eagerness to learn, a can-do attitude, and an interest (and ideally some experience working) in the payments industry

  • A solutions-oriented attorney who doesn’t rabbit-hole on theoretical risk but instead focuses on practical risk-based solutions to legal issues

  • Experience drafting and negotiating contracts for payments companies, fintech companies or financial institutions

  • An understanding of laws and regulations pertaining to financial services and technology (including Payment Services Directives; Anti-Money Laundering Directives; GDPR; Interchange Fee Regulations and EBA Guidelines)

  • A keen sense of ownership, and adaptability to a fast-changing environment

  • Sound judgment and ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively

  • Willingness and ability to support colleagues and initiatives across multiple time zones

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). One day you might be coaching a manager through a performance improvement plan, handling an employee relations case (disciplinary, grievance, or absence management), or updating HR policies to keep pace with changing employment legislation. The next, you could be drafting offer letters and onboarding new hires, analysing turnover trends in Workday, or coordinating interactive learning workshops and employee engagement activities.

data.title: Engineering Leader
data.description:
About Ema

Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Leader to manage and scale multiple product lines in the Voice, BPO, and Workforce Management space. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of real-time voice systems, operations research, and data-intensive platform engineering.

You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the engineering organization that builds the infrastructure powering Ema’s Voice AI Employees, Agent QA, auto-learning pipelines, rich analytics, and workforce optimization capabilities — all operating as scalable, multi-tenant systems deployed across global geographies.

You will collaborate with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to translate customer needs into production systems that handle high volumes of voice data, deliver real-time insights, and continuously improve through automated learning loops. As the owner of multiple product lines, you will balance roadmap priorities across Voice, BPO operations, and WFM (work force management) — ensuring each product evolves cohesively while meeting distinct customer needs.

What You Will Do

Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems

  • Architect and build multi-tenant systems that serve enterprise customers across geographies with strict data residency, isolation, and compliance requirements.

  • Design high-throughput ingestion systems capable of processing large volumes of voice data, call metadata, and operational telemetry in near real-time.

  • Make foundational architectural decisions on data stores, stream processing, and storage tiers — balancing query performance, cost, and operational simplicity.

  • Champion SOLID principles, clean architecture, and engineering rigor across all codebases — ensuring systems are testable, extensible, and maintainable at scale.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

  • Recruit, hire, and develop senior engineers across a multi-disciplinary function spanning voice engineering, backend systems, data engineering, and applied operations research.

  • Establish engineering standards, code review culture, and a strong bias toward shipping — with equal commitment to system reliability and customer experience.

  • Coach and grow senior/staff engineers into technical leaders; manage engineering managers as the organization scales.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure the platform evolves in lockstep with customer needs and market feedback.

Voice Platform & Agent QA

  • Own the end-to-end engineering for Ema’s AgentQA capabilities — real-time voice pipelines, telephony integrations, and voice-to-action workflows.

  • Build and scale the Agent QA platform: automated call scoring, compliance monitoring, sentiment analysis, and coaching feedback loops.

  • Design auto-learning systems that continuously improve voice agents from production interactions — closed-loop feedback, model retraining triggers, and quality regression detection.

  • Deliver rich voice analytics: call volume trends, handle time distributions, first-call resolution metrics, agent performance dashboards, and anomaly detection.

  • Build scalable voice pipeline across geographies – keeping in mind PII, security and compliance requirements.

Workforce Management & Operations Research

  • Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization.

  • Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations.

  • Partner with ML/AI teams to integrate predictive models for call volume forecasting, attrition risk, and staffing efficiency.

What We Look For

Required

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years leading engineering teams of 8+ engineers at high-growth startups or top-tier tech companies.

  • Deep expertise in building real-time, data-intensive systems.

  • Strong foundation in data stores and storage systems: relational databases, time-series stores, columnar analytics engines, and caching layers — with the judgment to choose the right tool for the workload.

  • Experience building quality software using AI-driven tools and workflows.

  • Track record of taking products from 0→1 and iterating rapidly based on customer feedback.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns — you write and review production code and lead by example on system design.

  • Experience building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms with data isolation, geo-distributed deployments, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Track record of building ingestion systems for high volumes of load — event-driven architectures, stream processing (Kafka, Flink, or equivalent), and batch/real-time hybrid pipelines.

  • Strong product sense: ability to deeply understand customer problems in contact center, voice, and workforce domains and translate them into clean technical solutions.

  • Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain high-caliber engineers across multiple disciplines in competitive markets.

Good to have

  • Experience in voice/telephony systems: WebRTC, SIP, voice-over-IP infrastructure, or contact center platforms.

  • Background in operations research or optimization: scheduling algorithms, linear/integer programming, constraint satisfaction, or demand forecasting models.

  • Experience building analytics platforms: OLAP systems, real-time dashboards, metric computation engines, or BI infrastructure.

  • Prior work on auto-learning or continuous improvement systems: feedback loops from production data, automated retraining pipelines, or quality monitoring systems.

  • Experience with AI/ML-powered products in enterprise settings — agentic automation, LLM orchestration, or AI-driven UX.

  • Familiarity with WFM or contact center operations — staffing models, Erlang-based capacity planning, or real-time adherence systems.

Why Ema

  • Build at the intersection of Voice AI, operations research, and enterprise-scale systems — a rare combination of deeply technical challenges with direct customer impact.

  • Shape the engineering foundation of a category-defining AI platform — your architectural decisions will power how the world’s largest enterprises run their voice and workforce operations.

  • High-impact, high-visibility role with direct access to the Head of Engineering, co-founders, and enterprise customers.

  • A team of exceptional engineers from Google, Meta, Microsoft Research, and top CS programs worldwide.

  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and the opportunity to build something that matters.

data.description:
A platform you can believe in: Immersive One is the leading cyber resilience solution across the globe.

Build and scale a best in class platform alongside a team of the brightest minds in cybersecurity! At Immersive, we’re uniquely positioned to future-proof organizations against any cyber challenge. If that excites you, read on!


Immersive helps prove and improve your cyber resilience, by simulating real-world threats, testing your skills, and measuring performance. We put your readiness to the ultimate test. From sharpening technical capabilities to making high-pressure decisions, our platform allows you to assess every angle, pinpoint areas for growth, and prove your ability to tackle evolving threats with unwavering confidence.

https://www.immersivelabs.com/why-immersive-labs


Immersive was founded in 2017, from a cargo container in Bristol, UK we’ve grown to over 300 employees globally, announced funding of more than £150 million and been voted a Best place to work on multiple occasions!

https://www.immersivelabs.com/company/our-story

Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Red Team

Immersive is hiring! Could you be our next Senior Cyber Security Engineer?

Due to customer demand and increasing maturity within our platform we have an exciting and challenging opportunity for an experienced cyber professional within the offensive security sector - with expertise in conducting red team engagements - to join our Product team as Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Red Team.

If successful you will join our Cyber team working closely with our Cyber Team Leads as we embark on this exciting new phase of product development within our market leading cyber resilience platform.

This isn’t an ordinary red team role - we know everyone claims this and will tell you their role is super unique…but this one really is.

You are constantly researching, learning, totally geeking out on all things offensive security related, from red teaming, to the latest AI driven attacks, and then taking that knowledge and creating labs and ranges.

You will be a key player in our Red Team Content team, shaping and influencing the roll out of our offensive security and AI pen test content roadmap, simulating attack paths and helping train our users to counter the latest threats.

You will be educating the world of offensive security professionals on how to make sure they are secure in what they do. Now that is a pretty cool legacy to leave behind.

Your mission (if you choose to accept it) is to evolve and disrupt within the Red Team space by creating emulated environments within our platform that will simulate both hacking and defending in an engaging and intuitive way for our community.

You will design, build and deliver practical and theory content to gamify offensive security and make it engaging and fun for the end user. You'll shake up traditional training and teach complex concepts in an innovative way.

If you have a passion for cyber security, are experienced in the area of offensive security, and want to disrupt how employees build their resilience against the latest threats we will appreciate your input and give you the space to innovate within our market leading platform, Immersive One.

Your main responsibilities (we're scaling fast, so these may change as we grow):

  • Utilising knowledge of pen test and red teaming engagements and techniques to plan, write and improve offensive security labs, challenges and online learning content on the Immersive One platform.

  • Produce multi-format content utilising various teaching methods; practical exercises, questions & gamification

  • Test Red Team labs and ranges to ensure they function as expected

  • Research vulnerabilities, tools and offensive tactics and compile this research to deliver practical and theory labs to users

  • Compile technical research into understandable concise content for both technical and non-technical audience

  • Work with the wider Product team on new projects and product innovations and how best to deploy them

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas:

  • A number of years of experience working in offensive security as a penetration tester or as a Offensive Security Consultant

  • In-depth knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how it is used to help enterprises deal with threats to their organisation.

  • Have a strong technical understanding of networking, computing and cyber security concepts

  • Have the ability to use examples and analogies to simplify complex subjects - your content will train real world users to identify and combat the latest threats so you need to be able to inhabit the mindset of your target audience to create realistic simulations

  • Familiarity with Linux, Docker and Python would be beneficial

  • Attitude and approach is just as important as technical skills for this role - you will be someone who enjoys tackling complex problems and finding the solution. You'll be a natural problem solver and 'tinkerer' who enjoys prototyping and iteration.

Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

  • Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

  • Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

  • Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

  • One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work. Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

  • Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and your birthday off

  • The longer you are with Immersive, the more holiday days you get, up to a maximum of 30 days after five years of service

  • Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover, 7% matched pension, private healthcare plan and more

  • Career and learning development through the platform, a dedicated professional development fund and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund - which enables you to learn anything that’s not work!

  • Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours

  • Informal or formal flexible working options, e.g. flexible start and finish times, reduced hours

  • We have a vibrant team culture with team events throughout the year. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to dungeons and dragons!

  • When you do visit the UK hub, getting there is easy: we’re based in the centre of Bristol, just a 10 minute walk from the train station. We also offer railcard loan and cycle scheme to buy a new bike

Find out more about life at Immersive Labs https://careers.immersivelabs.com


Cyber threats wait for no one and neither should you. Apply now!

What is Jedox?

Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.

Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management.


Your Responsibilities

As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success.

We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together.

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory.

  • Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features.
  • Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning.
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number.
  • Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market.
  • Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners.
  • Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities.
  • Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success.


Your Profile

  • Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function.
  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions.
  • Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together.

data.title: Operations Manager - Projektsteuerung & Projektabschluss (m/w/d)
data.description:
VIGOWATT ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Photovoltaik und Energietechnik mit Sitz in Paderborn. Wir betreuen Projekte von der Vorbereitung über die Montage und technische Umsetzung bis zum vollständigen Projektabschluss.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine strukturierte, durchsetzungsstarke und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung für laufende Projekte übernimmt und dafür sorgt, dass offene Themen nicht liegen bleiben.

Bei uns bekommst du keinen vollständig vorbereiteten Vorgang nach dem anderen auf den Tisch. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, findest selbstständig heraus, warum ein Projekt nicht weitergeht, und führst es konsequent bis zum Abschluss.

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Betreuung und Nachverfolgung laufender Projekte bis zum vollständigen Abschluss
  • Analyse und Klärung, warum Projekte, Rechnungen oder einzelne Arbeitsschritte noch offen sind
  • Aktives Nachfassen bei Kunden, Elektrikern, Netzbetreibern, Nachunternehmern und Geschäftspartnern
  • Koordination fehlender Montage-, Service- und Nacharbeitstermine
  • Nachverfolgung von Netzanschlüssen, Anmeldungen, Dokumentationen und fehlenden Unterlagen
  • Koordination und Nachverfolgung technischer Restarbeiten und Mängelbeseitigungen
  • Bearbeitung und Koordination von Kundenreklamationen und komplexeren Kundenfällen
  • Sicherstellung einer professionellen und nachvollziehbaren Kundenkommunikation
  • Prüfung und Nachverfolgung offener Rechnungen sowie Klärung der Ursachen ausstehender Zahlungen
  • Priorisierung offener Projekte nach Dringlichkeit und wirtschaftlicher Bedeutung
  • Setzen und konsequentes Nachhalten von Fristen
  • Vorbereitung komplexer oder rechtlicher Vorgänge für Geschäftsführung oder externe Berater
  • Dokumentation sämtlicher Vereinbarungen, offenen Punkte und nächsten Schritte in unseren digitalen Systemen
  • Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Montage, Projektvorbereitung und Buchhaltung
  • Aktive Mitarbeit an der Verbesserung unserer internen Abläufe und Projektprozesse

Wichtig: Für uns bedeutet „bearbeitet“ nicht, dass eine E-Mail verschickt wurde. Ein Vorgang ist erst dann wirklich bearbeitet, wenn das Problem gelöst wurde oder ein klarer nächster Schritt mit Verantwortlichem und verbindlichem Termin feststeht.

Qualifikation

Für diese Position suchen wir keine reine Sachbearbeitung, sondern eine Person, die Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmt.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Operations Management, technischen Projektmanagement oder einer vergleichbaren koordinierenden Tätigkeit gesammelt hast
  • sehr selbstständig und strukturiert arbeitest
  • Probleme eigenständig analysierst und Ursachen herausfindest
  • gerne telefonierst und aktiv auf Kunden, Partner und Dienstleister zugehst
  • konsequent nachfasst und auch unangenehmen Gesprächen nicht aus dem Weg gehst
  • mehrere offene Vorgänge gleichzeitig priorisieren und nachverfolgen kannst
  • Entscheidungen vorbereitest, statt Probleme lediglich weiterzugeben
  • verbindlich, freundlich und gleichzeitig durchsetzungsfähig kommunizierst
  • wirtschaftlich denkst und verstehst, wie wichtig ein vollständiger Projektabschluss für ein Unternehmen ist
  • sicher mit digitalen Arbeits- und Projektmanagementsystemen umgehen kannst
  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt

Erfahrung aus Photovoltaik, Energietechnik, Elektrohandwerk, Bau, Handwerk oder technischem Projektmanagement ist von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Entscheidend ist für uns weniger deine konkrete Branche als deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in komplexe Sachverhalte einzuarbeiten und offene Themen konsequent zum Abschluss zu bringen.

Benefits

  • Großer eigener Verantwortungs- und Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien
  • Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Strukturen aktiv mit aufzubauen
  • Moderner und digital organisierter Arbeitsplatz
  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten ohne starre Konzernstrukturen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten nach Absprache
  • Teilweise mobiles Arbeiten nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung und Absprache
  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Möglichkeit, deinen Verantwortungsbereich mit dem Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln
  • Kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort

Zusätzliche erfolgsabhängige Vergütung: Wenn du deinen Verantwortungsbereich erfolgreich entwickelst und messbar dazu beiträgst, Projekte schneller abzuschließen und offene Vorgänge nachhaltig zu reduzieren, besteht die Möglichkeit einer individuellen Bonusvereinbarung.

Wir suchen bewusst keine Person, die lediglich Aufgabenlisten abarbeitet.

Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, Ursachen hinterfragst und Freude daran hast, aus einem festgefahrenen oder unübersichtlichen Vorgang einen sauber abgeschlossenen Fall zu machen, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Uns interessiert dabei nicht nur dein Lebenslauf. Im Bewerbungsprozess möchten wir insbesondere erfahren, wie du in der Vergangenheit schwierige Projekte, offene Kundenfälle oder Situationen gelöst hast, bei denen zunächst nicht klar war, wie es weitergeht.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

data.title: Projektleiter:in Elektrotechnik - Unterwerke, 100 % (a) | Region: Ostschweiz
data.description:
Projektleiter:in Elektrotechnik - Unterwerke

Je nach Erfahrung auch als Senior-Rolle mit erweiterter Gesamtverantwortung möglich. Standort: Schweiz

Du kennst das: Unterwerke, die nicht am Stadtrand, sondern mitten im Gebirge stehen. Zufahrten, die eine Herausforderung für sich sind. Wetterfenster, die den Bauzeitplan bestimmen. Genau in diesem Umfeld suchen wir dich.

Für unseren Mandanten, ein etabliertes Schweizer Energieversorgungsunternehmen mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt in alpinen, ländlich geprägten Regionen, suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit für die technische Projektierung und Projektleitung von Unterwerksanlagen im Mittel- und Hochspannungsbereich.

Aufgaben

Das erwartet dich

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Projekte an Unterwerksanlagen – von der technischen Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme
  • Du planst und entwirfst Systeme, Komponenten und Konzepte für Neuanlagen, Umbauten und Erneuerungen im Mittel- und Hochspannungsbereich
  • Du führst Berechnungen und Auslegungen durch und beurteilst technische Lösungsvarianten
  • Du erstellst Ausschreibungsunterlagen, holst Offerten ein und evaluierst Anbieter
  • Du steuerst Termine, Kosten und Schnittstellen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Projektablauf
  • Du koordinierst und führst Projektteams sowie externe Lieferanten
  • Du begleitest Bewilligungsverfahren mit den zuständigen Behörden
  • Du bewegst dich dabei regelmässig direkt vor Ort – in Tälern und Bergregionen, nicht im Grossraumbüro

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Studium oder Weiterbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik (FH/HF/Uni) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Engineering von Unterwerksanlagen sowie in der Leitung von Projekten im Bereich Energieverteilung – idealerweise in topografisch anspruchsvollem Gelände
  • Fundierte elektrotechnische Kenntnisse im Mittel- und Hochspannungsbereich, Erfahrung in Leit- und Schutztechnik von Vorteil
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil
  • Vernetztes Denken, Eigenständigkeit und hohe Einsatzbereitschaft
  • Freude daran, dort zu arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen – und Bereitschaft, dafür auch mal weitere Wege in Kauf zu nehmen

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine Position mit echter Gestaltungsverantwortung statt reiner Zuarbeit
  • Ein Umfeld, das alpine Energieinfrastruktur seit über 100 Jahren prägt
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen – auch für Grenzgänger:innen aus Deutschland und Österreich. Solltest du die in Region umziehen, begleitet dich CONCAPE dabei Schritt für Schritt und gibt dir alle notwendigen Infos.

data.title: Sales Engineer (m/f/x)
data.description:
You’re the person we bring in when a customer’s logistics setup doesn’t fit our standard playbook. You dive into processes, TMS and logistic environments most teams can’t touch and build out an approach. You’ll work across Sales, Integration and Product, lean on automation wherever it saves you grunt work.

  • Mission: We’re revolutionizing road freight communication, digitalizing one of the world’s largest industries by leveraging the world’s most favorite apps: WhatsApp, iMessages, Android Messages, Telegram and Viber.
  • Proof: 70+ paying customers incl. Dachser, Hellmann, Coca-Cola EP. Backed by 20VC and Supply Chain Ventures.
  • Market: €500bn road freight, low software penetration → SaaS and AI leverage potential.
  • Pace: High-paced environment with strong application of AI toolset.

Tasks

  • Analyze complex customer logistics processes and define ZeKju's optimal solution and implementation strategy.
  • Support strategic prospects throughout the sales journey — from Discovery and Solution Design to Onboarding.
  • Translate customer requirements into scalable product and integration concepts in close collaboration with Product and Engineering.
  • Lead technical workshops with customers, partners and IT teams to align on architecture, processes and implementation.
  • Design and document customer workflows, integration concepts and solution blueprints that can be reused across projects.
  • Specify product enhancements for non-standard customer requirements and take ownership of selected product areas.
  • Act as the technical counterpart to Sales, helping shape proposals, demos, proof of concepts and customer presentations.
  • Coordinate customers, IT vendors and internal teams around a single implementation plan and ensure successful execution.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize implementations and continuously improve internal processes and best practices.
  • Leverage AI and automation to accelerate analysis, documentation, solution design and implementation planning.

Requirements

  • Several years in process management, IT consulting, product ownership, or similar ideally in supply chain/logistics.
  • Strong analytical skills - top-down thinker, doesn’t miss details or drown in them.
  • Good understanding of technical setups (REST API, SFTP, EDI etc.). Familiarity with logistic processes and/or systems are a plus.
  • Comfortable running multi-stakeholder projects across customers, vendors and internal teams.
  • German and English strong/ fluent. Other languages are considered a plus.
  • Bonus: warehouse/yard process knowledge, MINT/WIING education, background from a fast-growth tech company.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + VSOPs.
  • Real ownership of ZeKju’s hardest customer situations from day one.
  • Clear path into leading ZeKju’s Sales Engineering function.
  • Hybrid setup with on-site presence in our Munich office.
  • Stay fit and healthy with a sponsored EGYM Wellpass subscription.
  • Work directly with the founders and across Sales, Product, Tech and Customer Success

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We care more about how you think through a messy problem than a perfect CV match. Apply today!

data.description:

data.title: SaaS - Startup sucht: Onboarding & Customer Support Manager mit Paid / Social Media Marketing Erfahrung (w/m/d) remote
data.description:
Mit DatAds haben wir uns ein großes Ziel gesetzt: Wir wollen den Ad Creative Prozess auf das nächste Level bringen.

Unsere Software ist die Brücke zwischen datengetriebenen Performance Marketing und innovativen Creative Teams. Damit ermöglichen wir Performance Marketern und Creative Designern optimal zusammenzuarbeiten und durch AI Analysen mehr erfolgreiche Werbeanzeigen zu erstellen.

Wir arbeiten mit einigen der größten eCommerce Brands und Marketing Agenturen zusammen, wie z.B. Holy, yfood, ahead, Rosental, Pammys, Beilmann, Perspective und vielen mehr.

Möchtest du Teil eines schnell wachsenden Marketing SaaS-Startups werden und die Reise von DatAds aktiv mitgestalten?

Wir sind ein kleines, vollständig remote arbeitendes Team. Unsere Gründer bringen komplementäre Expertise mit: Max führt den Commercial-Bereich, während unser Daniel (Ex Hubspot) die technische Seite leitet. Ergänzt wird das Team durch eine Tech Person und eine Customer Care Person mit ähnlichem Profil.

Aufgaben

  • Kundenerfolg & Beratung: Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer eCom- & Agency-Kunden. Du analysierst bestehende Setups, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und hilfst, DatAds effektiver in ihren täglichen Prozessen zu integrieren.
  • Customer Support: Durchführung von regelmäßigen Calls mit Kunden, Unterstützung über Slack und aktive Begleitung bei strategischen Fragen rund um ihre Creatives & Kampagnen.
  • Upselling & Reaktivierung: Identifizierung von Wachstumschancen bei bestehenden Kund:innen und proaktives Ansprechen von inaktiven oder früheren Leads über unser CRM.
  • Kommunikation & Content: Erstellung von Texten, E-Mails und kurzen Updates zur Kundenbindung, Erfolgskommunikation und Unterstützung von Sales-Aktivitäten.
  • Zusammenarbeit & Eigeninitiative: Enge Abstimmung mit den beiden Gründern Max und Daniel, Einbringen eigener Ideen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer internen Prozesse.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Performance Ads (z. B. Meta, Google, LinkedIn oder TikTok) – sowohl im operativen Kampagnenmanagement als auch im strategischen Aufbau.
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in einer Agentur oder als Freelancer:in – du kennst die Dynamik, Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative, die das mit sich bringt.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität – du packst an, statt nur zu analysieren, und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Growth Mindset & Eigenmotivation: Du willst Ergebnisse sehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas aufbauen.
  • Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten in Kundenkommunikation – sowohl schriftlich als auch in Video Calls.
  • Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Berufliches Wachstum: Du wirst aktiv in spannende Projekte eingebunden und hast eine hohe Eigenverantwortung für deine Aufgaben. Eine steile Lernkurve ist garantiert.
  • Dynamische Start-up-Atmosphäre: Schnelle Kommunikations- und Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien, ein talentiertes und motiviertes Founder Team und gemeinsame Celebrations von Erfolgen.
  • Flexibilität bei der Arbeit: Passe deine Arbeitszeiten deinen Bedürfnissen an und genieße die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten + 25 Tage Urlaub

data.title: Head of Sales (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir sind ein junges, schnell wachsendes IT-Consulting-Unternehmen. Für unsere Kunden sind wir Problemlöser in den Bereichen Customer Service, CRM und AI. Dies erreichen wir mit viel Kreativität, Transparenz und Ehrgeiz, was uns bei Kunden von Start-ups bis hin zu Konzernen zu bewährten Partnern macht.

Als erster Chief Revenue Officer bei Leafworks übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

  • Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst Du unsere kommerzielle Strategie weiter.
  • Du baust Sales, Marketing, Customer Success und Partner Management zu einer gemeinsamen Commercial Organisation aus.
  • Du schaffst Strukturen für nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum.
  • Du gestaltest die Zukunft von Leafworks aktiv mit – mit Perspektive auf die Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer kommerziellen Wachstumsstrategie
  • Ausbau der Neukundengewinnung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Sales-Ansatzes
  • Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Lead-Pipeline gemeinsam mit Marketing
  • Professionalisierung unseres Key Account Managements und Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling
  • Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Forecasting, Pricing und Sales-Prozessen
  • Optimierung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Consulting, Entwicklung und Customer Success
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und aktive Mitgestaltung unserer nächsten Unternehmensphase
  • Positionierung unserer AI- und Customer-Experience-Lösungen im Markt

Qualifikation

Du bist kein klassischer Vertriebsleiter und auch kein Konzern-CRO. Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst pragmatisch und packst selbst mit an.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Commercial-, Revenue- oder Sales-Führungsrolle
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau von profitablem Wachstum
  • Erfahrung mit Enterprise Sales oder Value Selling
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau strukturierter Sales- und Revenue-Prozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM, Forecasting und Pipeline Management
  • Verständnis für Marketing, Customer Success und Account Management
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Consulting-, SaaS- oder Software-Umfeld

Benefits

Wir sind ein internationales, bunt gemischtes, ähnlich tickendes Team. Wir schauen erst aufs Menschliche und danach auf die Skills, in dieser Reihenfolge. Egal welche Ausbildung Du hast, wie alt Du bist, wo Du wohnst, wo Du herkommst oder wie dein Lebenslauf aussieht: Come as you are and be yourself!

  • Mikro-Management ist nicht dein Stil? Unserer auch nicht: Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit selbst einteilen und wir arbeiten 100 % remote. Ab und zu mal Lust auf ein Co-Working mit LWees in deiner Nähe? Jederzeit gerne.
  • Das Ergebnis zählt: Wie Du arbeitest, entscheidest Du.
  • Vertrauensbasis: Vertrauen ist alles. Punkt.
  • Remote is where the magic happens: Was Du zum Arbeiten an Equipment brauchst, bekommst Du.
  • Get to the Next level: Weiterbildungen, Trainings oder Schulungen? Sprich uns direkt an, auch das gehört dazu.
  • Stay connected: Durch regelmäßigen Austausch und Feedback-Talks leben wir Transparenz und Offenheit.
  • Prepare for challenges: Langweilige Projekte wirst Du bei uns nicht finden. Sei bereit, aus deiner Komfortzone rauszukommen.
  • Here to stay: Wir bauen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Befristete Arbeitsverträge haben wir nicht.
  • Dresscode: Nein danke.
  • Das WIR zählt: Durch die zahlreichen Co-Workings und Teamevents in Deutschland und im Ausland stärken wir unseren Zusammenhalt und unsere ganz besondere LW-Kultur.
  • Starte direkt durch: Ein Onboarding, das dich ankommen lässt. Dein Onboarding-Buddy steht dir ab dem ersten Tag zur Seite.

Hört sich cool an? Super, dann schick uns doch einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht!

data.description:
Ausbildungsplatz zur Medizinischen Fachangestellten (m/w/d) ab 2027

Moderne orthopädische Gemeinschaftspraxis in zentraler Lage in Butzbach bietet Ausbildungsplatz mit frühzeitigem Einstieg als bezahlte/r Trainee

Wir sind eine moderne orthopädische Gemeinschaftspraxis mit einem engagierten und freundlichen Team. Die individuell passende Behandlung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten steht für uns an erster Stelle.

Für das Ausbildungsjahr 2027 suchen wir eine/n motivierte/n Auszubildende/n zur/zum Medizinischen Fachangestellten (MFA) (m/w/d).

Das Besondere: Du musst nicht bis zum Ausbildungsbeginn warten! Bereits ab sofort hast du die Möglichkeit, unser Team als bezahlte/r Trainee zu unterstützen, erste Berufserfahrungen zu sammeln und unsere Praxis und ihre Abläufe kennenzulernen. Mit Beginn des Ausbildungsjahres 2027 startest du dann direkt deine Ausbildung bei uns.

data.title: FP&A & Performance Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Über uns

Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen.

Gute Entscheidungen beginnen mit belastbaren Zahlen, klaren KPIs und einem realistischen Blick nach vorn. Als FP&A Manager verbindest du Unternehmensplanung, Projektperformance und Management Reporting zu einer aussagekräftigen Steuerungslogik. Du analysierst nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern machst früh sichtbar, wo Handlungsbedarf und neue Chancen entstehen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die integrierte Fünfjahresplanung der ju:niz-Gruppe und entwickelst sie laufend weiter.
  • Strategische Ziele übersetzt du in belastbare Finanzpläne, Szenarien und relevante Steuerungsgrößen.
  • Ein integriertes Finanzmodell für GuV, Bilanz, Cashflow, Capex, Finanzierung und Liquidität baust du auf und pflegst es eigenständig.
  • Unternehmens- und Projektbewertungen sowie Sensitivitäts- und Szenarioanalysen erstellst du fundiert und adressatengerecht.
  • Mit Strategy arbeitest du eng an strategischen Optionen, Wachstumsinitiativen und Managemententscheidungen.
  • Auf Gruppen- und Portfolioebene entwickelst und überwachst du zentrale KPIs. Projektbezogene POC-Informationen konsolidierst du für das Performance Management und machst wesentliche Werttreiber, Chancen und Risiken frühzeitig sichtbar.
  • Geschäftsführung und Management unterstützt du mit aussagekräftigen Reports, Analysen und Entscheidungsunterlagen für die finanzielle und strategische Steuerung.
  • Planungs- und Bewertungsannahmen stimmst du mit den Fachbereichen ab und professionalisierst unsere FP&A-, Reporting- und Analyseprozesse.
  • Als Business Partner arbeitest du eng mit CFO, Management sowie unseren Projekt- und Investmentteams zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance, Accounting oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.
  • Drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Business Controlling, Transaction Advisory oder einer führenden Unternehmens- beziehungsweise Strategieberatung passen gut zu dieser Rolle.
  • Projektgeschäft, komplexe Business Cases und idealerweise ein Private-Equity-, Scale-up-, Infrastruktur- oder Energieumfeld sind dir vertraut.
  • P&L, Bilanz und Cashflow denkst du integriert; Budgetierung, Management Reporting, KPI-Steuerung und POC-basierte Projektanalysen beherrschst du sicher.
  • Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und überzeugst in Financial Modelling, IRR- und Bewertungslogiken; Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics oder LucaNet ist ein Plus.
  • Du kombinierst analytische Tiefe mit unternehmerischem Denken, klarer Kommunikation und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Deutsch sprichst du fließend und Englisch sicher. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit CFO und Fachbereichen arbeitest du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München.

Warum wir?

  • Eine sichtbare Rolle im Zentrum der Unternehmenssteuerung mit direktem Zugang zu CFO und Management.
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau moderner FP&A- und Performance-Management-Strukturen.
  • Schnelle Lernkurve durch anspruchsvolle Business Cases und investitionsintensive BESS-Projekte.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Eigenverantwortung und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Analysen Konsequenzen haben.
  • Flexible Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßiger Präsenz und engem fachlichen Austausch im Team.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

Dein Ansprechpartner
Moritz Erlbeck
People Growth & Hiring Lead

data.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year.

You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices.

Your responsibilities

  • Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository

  • Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate

  • Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost

  • Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security

  • Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training

  • Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain

  • Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework

About you

  • Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company

  • Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost

  • Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system

  • A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency

  • AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar).

  • German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy

  • Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns

  • Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would

  • A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Moss is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star and Portage.

We have a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe. Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

data.title: Data Engineer - Data Platform & Ontology (m/f/d)
data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the Role

As Data Engineer on our Healthcare Platform, you will own the foundational data ingestion, entity-resolution, and platform infrastructure end-to-end. You will design and operate scalable batch/streaming data pipelines, harden platform orchestration, and ensure system reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology—a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards. Working closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Methodology experts, you will turn heterogeneous, multi-country hospital data into a coherent, highly queryable data asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Infrastructure & Orchestration: Build, optimize, and operate reliable ELT pipelines (using Python, SQL, and Prefect/Airflow) to ingest data from heterogeneous international sources, APIs, databases, and lakehouse storage (S3, Apache Iceberg).

  • Healthcare Ontology & Entity Resolution: Drive the implementation of entity resolution and master data management (MDM) for international hospital entities, mapping raw source data to canonical structures and maintaining standardized vocabularies (e.g., ICD/OPS, specialty taxonomies).

  • Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

  • Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster).

  • Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

  • Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

  • Metadata & Lineage Tooling: Experience operating metadata registries and lineage catalogs (e.g., OpenMetadata, DataHub, dbt docs).

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments.

Your Profile

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 3+ years in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core platform or product through build → launch → iteration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Healthcare domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital structures and medical classification systems like ICD/OPS is especially valuable).

  • Mindset: Strong analytical and systems mindset, with a proven ability to transform messy, heterogeneous international data into a clean, well-governed, and highly structured data asset.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus.

  • Working Style: Highly structured, curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and methodology experts in an international environment.

data.title: DevOps Engineering Intern (Nix, NixOS, Rust)
data.description:
atvari is a technology company specializing in software and cloud architecture, custom software engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, and IT consulting. The team is passionate about building robust, modern solutions with a strong focus on Rust, Nix, and open-source technologies. atvari values clean, maintainable code and collaborative engineering practices. Applicants can expect to work in an environment that encourages learning, experimentation, and contribution to the open-source community.

Tasks

Role Description

As a DevOps Engineering Intern at atvari, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of Nix-based development and deployment environments. You will assist in writing and refining Nix and NixOS configurations, automating build and deployment workflows, and integrating Nix with existing software projects. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with engineers on backend services, troubleshooting environment and dependency issues, and documenting configuration and tooling. This is a fully remote internship, where you will work closely with the engineering team and gain hands-on experience with Rust, Nix, and cloud-native practices.

Internship Details

This is an unpaid internship for the duration of 1-3 months based on your needs. It is either offered as a voluntary internship (Freiwilliges Praktikum) or a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) and it is only available to German residents.

You are eligible if one of these conditions apply to you:

  • you do not have a completed apprenticeship or university degree (Freiwilliges Praktikum)
  • you need a mandatory internship as part of a degree program (Pflichtpraktikum)

Requirements

  • Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.

data.description:
Wir sind ein junges, stark wachsendes und eigenfinanziertes („bootstrapped“) Startup, das KI-Agenten für den Vertriebsinnendienst im produzierenden Gewerbe und Großhandel entwickelt.

Unsere Kunden kommen häufig aus dem deutschen Mittelstand und verkaufen Sensoren, Medizinprodukte oder Hygieneartikel. Anfragen und Aufträge erreichen die Unternehmen meistens per E-Mail und werden heute manuell durch den Vertriebsinnendienst bearbeitet. Das ist sehr zeitintensiv und teuer – und stiehlt wertvolle Kapazität für verkaufsfördernde Aktivitäten. Unsere KI-Agenten erfassen selbständig Aufträge, erstellen Angebote, beraten zu Produkten oder leiten E-Mails an den richtigen Ansprechpartner weiter. Dies steigert die Effizienz um >75%.

Aufgaben

Als Go-To-Market Working Student bringst du Marketing und Content bei enmit auf das nächste Level. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Nicolas, unserem Gründer, zusammen. Du bekommst von Anfang an Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Dinge selbst voranzutreiben. Dabei geht es unter anderem um:

  • Bring andere dazu, über uns zu sprechen (durch Presse- und Blogartikel zu Podcast- und Interview-Einladungen)
  • Sprich über uns (Content Creation für Social Media, Erstellung von edukativen Inhalten (Unternehmensblog, Video))
  • Verschaffe uns Bühnen (Vor- und Nachbereitung von Webinaren, Events (Sourcing von Opportunitäten, Koordination, Promotion))
  • Verbessere unsere Markenvisibilität (SEO & GEO, Newsletter, Social Media Advertising, Erstellung von Präsentationen)

Qualifikation

  • Du bist kreativ, Storytelling macht dir Spaß und du hast ein Gefühl dafür, was 2026 im B2B Marketing funktioniert
  • Große Neugier und ein ungezähmter Wille, Neues zu lernen, zeichnen dich aus. Für deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe bist du bekannt
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Marketing / in der Content Erstellung und hast klare, beeindruckende Ergebnisse erzielt
  • Neue AI Tools integrierst du schnell in deine Arbeitsweise
  • Du möchtest 20 Std. die Woche arbeiten, zu 90% vor Ort in unserem Büro in München
  • Dein Deutsch ist auf Muttersprachniveau, dein Englisch auf C1/C2-Level

Benefits

Deine Zeit bei uns wird intensiv, bereichernd und FUN. Wir haben eine „Get Stuff Done“ Mentalität und einen hohen Selbstanspruch. Wir sind Office-First – gerade als Werkstudent kannst du so viel aufsaugen, fragen und lernen. Interne Meetings halten wir auf ein Minimum und lösen Probleme kollaborativ, wenn sie auftauchen. Du bekommst schnelles, ehrliches und konstruktives Feedback. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Dinge selbst vorantreibst und Ownership zeigst.

Unser Gründer Nicolas hat eine große Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von jungen Führungspersönlichkeiten. Bei McKinsey und in seinem vorherigen Startup hat er über 20 Young Professionals gefördert. Heute sind sie selbst Unternehmer, arbeiten in Tech-Konzernen (Google, Amazon), in Startup-Führungspositionen, in führenden Strategieberatungen (z.B. BCG) oder im Private Equity.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

data.title: Rust Software Engineering Intern
data.description:
atvari is a technology company specializing in software and cloud architecture, custom software engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, and IT consulting. The team is passionate about building robust, modern solutions with a strong focus on Rust, Nix, and open-source technologies. atvari values clean, maintainable code and collaborative engineering practices. Applicants can expect to work in an environment that encourages learning, experimentation, and contribution to the open-source community.

Tasks

Role Description

As a Rust Software Engineering Intern at atvari, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of Rust-based software projects. Additionally, you will assist in writing and refining Nix and NixOS configurations, automating build and deployment workflows, and integrating Nix with existing software projects. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with engineers on backend services, troubleshooting environment and dependency issues, and documenting configuration and tooling. This is a fully remote internship, where you will work closely with the engineering team and gain hands-on experience with Rust, Nix, and cloud-native practices.

Internship Details

This is an unpaid internship for the duration of 1-3 months based on your needs. It is either offered as a voluntary internship (Freiwilliges Praktikum) or a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) and it is only available to German residents.

You are eligible if one of these conditions apply to you:

  • you do not have a completed apprenticeship or university degree (Freiwilliges Praktikum)
  • you need a mandatory internship as part of a degree program (Pflichtpraktikum)

Requirements

  • Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.
  • Exposure to Software Development and Programming, with experience in at least one high-level language (Rust experience is a plus).
  • Understanding of Back-End Web Development concepts, such as APIs, microservices, and server-side frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Functional Programming (FP) principles and their practical application in codebases.
  • Interest in Nix / NixOS, reproducible builds, DevOps, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to learn quickly, work in a team setting, and communicate clearly about technical topics.
  • Comfort working remotely in Germany and collaborating in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Benefits

Our Tech Stack

  • Nix / NixOS
  • Rust
  • TypeScript & React
  • Kubernetes & Podman
  • OpenTofu / Terraform
  • gRPC, Protobuf & buf
  • GraphQL
  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir
  • OpenTelemetry
  • WebAssembly
  • OpenCode & Claude Code
  • GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo
  • Hetzner Cloud, GCP, AWS, Azure, OpenStack

Other tools we use:

  • Proton Workspace (Proton Mail, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, Proton Meet, Proton Lumo AI)
  • Element / Matrix
